claims.text: Changing the elemental percentages in HfNbTaTiZr HEA will affect its mechanical properties.
Elemental-percentage changes in HfNbTaTiZr HEA can alter its crystal structure.
Elemental-percentage changes in HfNbTaTiZr HEA can alter lattice distortion.
Solid-solution strengthening is a mechanism connecting composition changes to mechanical-property changes in HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Lattice strain is a mechanism connecting composition changes to mechanical-property changes in HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Changing elemental percentages may improve or deteriorate the strength of HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Changing elemental percentages may improve or deteriorate the hardness of HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Changing elemental percentages may improve or deteriorate the ductility of HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Solubility limits and phase stability constrain the relevant composition range in the HfNbTaTiZr system.
The effects of composition can be investigated by systematically varying elemental percentages and performing tensile, hardness, and microstructural tests.
Finding no significant correlation between elemental percentages and mechanical properties would falsify the hypothesis.
